reviews.title: It’s just a picture
reviews.text: You can’t tap on anything- it’s just a picture. It asks you to subscribe and if you don’t then you get nothing. From what I understand if you do subscribe, you still get barely anything.

reviews.title: Scam!
reviews.text: The ENTIRE APP is NON-FUNCTIONAL unless you pay money! NO ASPECT OF THIS APP is useable without paying money !

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: Total scam of an app like others have said. No idea how this has any stars. Avoid.
